event_summary: A folded white card on a black tabletop base changes orientation while an orange sphere in a blue-and-black holder becomes hidden and later briefly reappears behind the card.
raw_event_description: At the start, a folded white card stands on a black circular base, and an orange textured sphere is visible near the top center inside a blue-and-black U-shaped holder. The white card changes from an oblique A-frame view to a broad front-facing panel that covers the central area and hides the orange sphere and much of the holder. A vertical black-and-silver rod remains visible above the card. Later, the card continues changing orientation to the opposite oblique view; parts of the blue-and-black holder and the orange sphere are briefly visible behind and between the white panels before the card again hides most of them.

reasons: The orange sphere, blue-and-black holder, folded white card, black circular base, cable, tabletop, and wall are visible.
The upper part of the holder is cropped by the top image edge.
The changing positions and visibility begin from the first visible frame rather than after a distinct pre-event pause.

evidence_bank.observation: The folded white card stands in an A-frame shape on the black circular base.
The orange sphere is visible near the top center inside the blue-and-black U-shaped holder.
A black cable extends from the base area toward the right side of the tabletop.
The folded white card is initially seen at an oblique angle with a narrow central ridge visible.
A broad white panel moves into the central front view.
The broad white panel hides the orange sphere from view.
The broad white panel hides most of the blue-and-black holder from view.
A vertical black-and-silver rod remains visible above the white card.
The white card presents a nearly rectangular front face across the base.
The white card shifts from the front-facing view toward an oblique view on the opposite side.
A blue part of the holder becomes visible behind the left side of the white card.
The orange sphere briefly appears low behind or between the white panels.
The white panels later hide the orange sphere again.
The tabletop edge and wall remain fixed in the frame.

observations: The main objects are visible together at the start.

object_events.observation: The folded card is visible as an oblique A-frame on the base.
The orange sphere is visible inside the holder.
The blue-and-black holder surrounds the visible orange sphere.

observations: The white card occupies the central front view.

object_events.observation: The broad white panel moves across the center and becomes nearly front-facing.
The orange sphere becomes hidden behind the white card.
Most of the holder becomes hidden behind the white card.
The vertical rod remains visible above the card.

observations: The card continues changing orientation after the front-facing view.

object_events.observation: The folded card changes to an oblique view with the other panel edge visible.
A blue section of the holder becomes partly visible behind the card.
The orange sphere briefly reappears low behind or between the white panels and then is hidden again.

unresolved_observations: The exact hidden connection among the card, base, holder, and vertical rod is not visible during much of the sequence.
